body.content: Exploration of topological definitions: If the pizza is an annulus (missing the center), 4 concurrent cuts yield 8 disconnected arc-like pieces. This highlights that the '8' result is robust to the topology of the domain, but the physical interpretation of a 'piece' changes from a wedge to a disconnected ring segment.
body.why_keep_this: Tests the boundary conditions of the 'exact center' constraint and the necessity of the disk assumption.
